answer_invariance.reason: design is full rank within MedQA constructions, but independent cross-source taxonomy generalization is unavailable (only one source family)

efficiency.pipeline_makespan_note: First-to-last wall timestamps measure this M0/M1 completion batch only. Prior M2/screening runtime and interruption limits are retained in prior_run_efficiency.json; aggregate stage times and logical tokens include reused history.
efficiency.cold_vs_reused: Exact complete M2 pipeline and 5832 prior predictions per reader reused; this batch executes only the 19448 missing calls per reader

prior_screening_reuse.reuse_basis: Independent byte-for-byte copies; all M2 stages and M1 initial retrieval stay fixed. No input, prompt, checkpoint, precision, decoding, parsing or seed changes.

incremental_expansion_workload.meaning: Only missing M0/M1 reader requests in this completion batch; all M2 and initial retrieval artifacts reused unchanged

efficiency.cache_hits_scope: Latest durable runtime record per worker; counters restart with each process. Exact historical input reuse and input deduplication are reported separately.

reader_completion.authorization: User requests completing previously stopped M0 and M1 on the same entire test set, with unchanged requirements and configuration.
reader_completion.reuse: Independent byte-for-byte copies; all M2 stages and M1 initial retrieval stay fixed. No input, prompt, checkpoint, precision, decoding, parsing or seed changes.

repeat.interpretation: noise estimate only; no ensemble or correction; unmapped/invalid pairs excluded from semantic flip denominator and retained in raw-output change

superseded_cross_slot_seed_overlap.interpretation: noise estimate only; no ensemble or correction; unmapped/invalid pairs excluded from semantic flip denominator and retained in raw-output change

mechanism_proxies.interpretation: retrieval overlap and document-source count associations; not evidence correctness, entailment, or causal failure

evaluation_scope: entire official test/released evaluation data; no source-group sampling
